create_APG_guidance: create an AdaptiveProjectedMixGuidance instance with custom guidance_scale and momentum parameters
build_momentum_buffer: build a MomentumBuffer with a given momentum value to track running averages of guidance differences
run_normalized_guidance: run normalized_guidance to apply adaptive projected guidance with orthogonal and parallel decomposition
update_momentum_buffer: update the momentum buffer with conditional and unconditional prediction differences
test_APG_forward: test the forward method of AdaptiveProjectedMixGuidance with conditional and unconditional predictions
